license_mode: Official externally hosted Free widget, not vendored or reimplemented. Visible provider attribution preserved; no token, account or paid subscription.
calculation: Provider engine calculates an annuity from user-entered price and annual rate. Rate and price start blank. Generic defaults: 30% down, 20 years; neither is a bank offer.
source_of_price: User input in this trial; Intrum/lot auto-fill remains unconnected
loading: Click Рассчитать ипотеку in #purchase loads same-origin mortgage.html. Provider scripts/CSS load only in that document; no automatic page jump on initial open.
resource_base: Child document sets base to https://calcus.ru/ after its own local CSS/deferred JS load, because provider supplemental CSS/chart URLs are root-relative. This does not change window.location.origin or attribution rules.
isolation: iframe isolates CSS and global vendor JS from existing forms. Height/theme postMessage checks exact origin, source window and finite values; height 240–2400px. Mortgage document alone also works.
style: Existing Tilda Sans, white background, burgundy #8b1d25, 1px radius, 58/70px buttons according to outer viewport. One column on narrow iframe layouts.
results: Monthly payment, interest and total paid. Optional provider charts/tables remain in DOM for callback compatibility but are visually hidden; provider calculation code is untouched.
failure: Load error/20s timeout shows retry and preserves provider link; no fabricated result. Labelled inputs, local validation/focus before submission; existing expert contact dialog remains separate.
network: Widget and calculations require Calcus. User-entered calculation parameters are sent to the provider; this is not a client-only formula. No lead/CRM transport added.
